# I5 · Hồ sơ mới

Group **I · Vận hành Clinic · bổ sung từ web** · detail screen · status: **ported**

> Web › patients › Hồ sơ mới · tìm trước khi tạo để tránh chia lịch sử

## Logic source
- Web: patients › Hồ sơ mới · tìm trước khi tạo để tránh chia lịch sử
- Web-only: logic ported from `prototype/shared/*.js` into the `shared/clinic` domain (`ClinicStore`, `transact` commands, `ClinicError` errors keep the web's Vietnamese messages).
- Permissions follow `prototype/shared/staff-context.js` (`pages` + `capabilities`) → `Session.allows` + `session.staffContext().can(...)`.
- Web `clinic.js` › patients() › "Hồ sơ mới"; the `createPatient` command (ClinicToolsCommands) also syncs `MutableCatalogRepository` so the new record appears in search.

## KMP
- Route: `Routes.NewPatient` ("new-patient") · app bar "Hồ sơ mới"
- Composable: `NewPatientScreen` — `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/ClinicToolsScreens.kt`
- Registered by graph: `clinicToolsGraph`
- `shared/clinic` domain functions imported by the file (shared by every screen in it): `createPatient`, `daysBetween`, `patient`, `viDate`
- Shot test: `pema-kmp/feature/patients/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/pema/clinic/feature/patients/ClinicToolsShotTest.kt:13` → `pema-kmp/feature/patients/build/shots/I5-vs.png`
- Canvas image: `pema-kmp/design-ref/I5.png`

- DetailScaffold(title = "Hồ sơ mới")  // back button, padding 20
